summary: Short kerb at the Moggill Road junction mouth; nowhere to stop clear of traffic.
reasons: No room to pull out of lane

drivers.seclusion: Open to Moggill Road; houses 16 m and more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Kerb curves round the junction mouth; shorter than a van and no cars park here.
drivers.convention: No parking at the junction; cars park further down the west kerb.

flags: Junction mouth on a main road
Slope up to 6.2% over one step
sun_shade: Tree canopy to the south-west; open to the north.
